feed.headline: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
feed.ai: Canada is seeking closer ties with EU after a breakdown in relations with the US and its president Donald Trump.
feed.frag: Highlights the limits of national coordination

feed.headline: Carney's new love-in with EU has everything to do with Trump
feed.ai: The Canadian PM is in Strasbourg this week seeking a "unique alliance" - and there is one clear catalyst.

feed.headline: Kosovo's former president sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
feed.ai: Hashim Thaci has been jailed for crimes including torture and murder during Kosovo's independence war with Serbia.

feed.headline: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
feed.ai: With more than 90% of ballots processed early on Monday, the left-wing bloc was in front by approximately 20,000 votes.

feed.headline: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter
feed.ai: The Danish prime minister has accused Russia of "reckless" behaviour, while the Kremlin is yet to comment.

feed.headline: Trump says he will remove all Irish whiskey tariffs as he ends two-day visit
feed.ai: Whiskey distilled in the Republic of Ireland faces the standard 15% tariff which applies to EU goods entering the US.

feed.headline: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
feed.ai: No casualties were reported after a Russian drone struck a train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials left the area.

feed.headline: E.U. Offers to Make Canada ‘Associate Member’ as U.S. Ties Weaken for Both
feed.ai: Canada and the European Union have been confronting an increasingly challenging relationship with the United States under President Trump.

feed.headline: Russia’s Election Result Won’t Be a Shock. What Comes Next Could Be.
feed.ai: Russians are braced for what may follow for the military and economy after a parliamentary election that the Kremlin sees as a means of legitimizing its policies.

feed.headline: Ukraine and Russia Say There Is No Energy Truce, Despite Trump’s Claims
feed.ai: The Kremlin said that an agreement would be “a very good idea” but that any deal would not have much effect on fuel markets, as President Trump had suggested.

feed.headline: What Is Driving Diesel Prices Up? Energy Chaos Caused by Two Wars.
feed.ai: President Trump recently blamed Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries for causing a spike in diesel prices, but analysts say the Iran war is probably a bigger factor.

feed.headline: Russian Strikes on Ukraine Hits Near David Petraeus, ex-C.I.A. Chief
feed.ai: David Petraeus was at a rail station when a drone hit. Another train, with former Prime Minister Boris Johnson of Britain and other dignitaries, had just left, Ukrainian officials said.
